text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval on the negotiated terms of the collective agreement with Unifor 2003E.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the negotiated terms of the collective agreement with Unifor 2003E, as outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 24, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 24, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it is about labour relations or employee negotiations.
